request.text: ...and the sand lay down, and the sand lay still, and the worm went under the hill. Sefa. I sing for my people, the Sand Singers. It grew. It sees. Nothing on two legs crosses its ground. A man with a coal in his hand fought it once, and ran. His song is the funniest we have. Keep your heads covered. The sun out here eats fools first.
request.voice_description: Native English, Welsh, a warm, melodic Welsh lilt. Female, 35-45. Excellent quality. Persona: the singer of a nomad people of the desert, who keeps their history in songs. Emotion: warm, playful, proud, serene, with a teasing humour. A rich, round, musical voice that half-sings even when she talks, unhurried and rhythmic; hushed and reverent when she speaks of the worm.
